Introduction
Lynch has returned with a dangerous new serum. Some Hunters fight to stop her, while others drink deep from Corruption's cup.
New Content
Chapter 1
During the event, players were able to enjoy some new additions to the game:
New Weapon: Burgess
Blood Moon Time of Day
New Traits: Siphon and Chupacabra
New Boss Target: Bloodskin (via the Make Them Bleed community challenge)
Chapter 2
Beginning October 6th, following changes were made to the event:
Return of the Inferno Time of Day including the Firefighter Supply, which holds a guaranteed Flame Rifle
Beginning October 13th, the All Hallows' Cleave community event (see below) added more features:
Return of the Bileweavers
New Monster variation: Bloodweavers (only during the Blood Moon Time of Day)
20 new infected Compounds (5 per map)
New Tarot Cards: The Atlas and The Temperance
New Tool: Long Derringer
Chapter 3
Beginning November 3rd, following changes were made to the event:
Reintroduction of the 20 infected Compounds from previous events (they now get shuffled with the 20 new ones, 5 per match are selected randomly)
Beginning November 17th, the Reap the Harvest community event (see below) added more features:
New Weapon: Lancaster
New Variant: Lancaster Cleaver
Event Points
Event points were gained in several ways:
Killing Hellhounds - 1 EP
Killing Hives and Armoreds - 2 EP
Killing Immolators and Firebreathers - 3 EP
Killing Meatheads and Brutes - 5 EP
Revealing Hidden Extractions and Locations - 3 EP
Investigating Clues or Rifts - 8 EP
Looting Hunter Corpses - 10 EP
Killing a Target, or Activating the Wellspring - 20 EP
Extracting with a Bounty or becoming the Soul Survivor - 30 EP
Complete Challenges - 750-1500 EP
Each Daily Milestone of Dark Tribute - 75 EP
Challenges
During Blood Testament, Weekly Challenges granted Event Points alongside 50 . Each week would give the chance to complete challenges, dedicated to exploration (such as visit 15 compounds), objectives (banish Targets 5 times), PvE (kill 100 monsters), or PvP (Deal 1500 damage with medium ammo). Reaching milestones within the week gave 750 EP, and 10 . Players who bought the Battle Pass got a bonus sixth challenge to complete, giving an extra 1500 EP.

Dark Tribute
Event Points could also be gained from each milestone of Dark Tribute. Reaching the 2000, 4000, 5500, and 8000 milestones granted 75 EP each daily. In addition, each Dark Tribute milestone granted a Tarot Card as normal.
Pledge Marks
Pledge Marks act as a currency to break Pledge Seals and purchase Event Traits. Hunters could hold onto a maximum of six Pledge Marks, and could receive an unlimited amount in a mission. As in previous events, Pledge Marks were able to be stolen from Hunter corpses upon looting them. Each time a Pledge Mark was gained, it was also rewarded across the team - except in the case of looting Pledge Marks from Hunters. There were four sources of Pledge Marks:
Reaching the Event Point Thresholds - Gaining 25 EP would reward 1 each time (meaning 50 EP, 75 EP, etc. also grants 1 )
Banishing a Target in Bounty Clash - 2
Becoming the Soul Survivor – The surviving Hunter would receive 3
Looting a Pledge Mark Envelope - 1-3
Stealing Pledge Marks - Looting a Hunter would steal all of the Hunter's accumulated Pledge Marks , retaining some only if the looting Hunter hit their maximum of 6 before looting them all.
Event Features
Blood Wells
Blood Wells spawned once in each compound, and could be interacted with (costing a small amount of health) to gain the Siphon trait. Doing so would frenzy nearby AI, similar to the effect of the Intense Blood Moon.
Event Traits
Siphon - Allows you to loot a Scarce Trait off an enemy Hunter's body, leaving Siphon in its place.
Is only available from the Blood Well
Death Cheat takes priority when stealing a scarce trait
Solo players are able to steal the Necromancer trait, but it cannot be stolen from other Solo players.
Chupacabra - Interact with a live horse, cow, or animal cage to restore 1 Health Chunk
Can be bought for 2 Upgrade Points
Burns after used on an animal, killing the animal in the process
Chicken coops can only be used once, while dog cages can be used multiple times, killing one dog at a time

Battle Pass & Rewards
To get the most out of the event, players could purchase the Battle Pass to unlock the premium progression, giving Weapon Charms, Inspect Animations, Legendary Skins, Blood Bonds, Hunters, as well as Badges, Frames, and Avatars for the Player Profile system. The Battle Pass itself came in two tiers with slightly different rewards:
Battle Pass - 1000
Unlocks Premium Progression
Unlocks extra Challenge rewards for faster progression
The Dark Friar
Premium Battle Pass - 2400
Unlocks Premium Progression
Unlocks extra Challenge rewards for faster progression
Immediately gives 15 levels of progression at a discount
The Dark Friar
Players could upgrade to the Premium Battle Pass after buying the normal one up until level 43 of the Battlepass, and they could buy event levels at a cost of 200 per level. All but the final Overspill Bonus Level could be bought.

Community Events
Make Them Bleed Promo
Make Them Bleed
Something feels off, lately. You find strange pools of blood and smell iron on the wind. A friar preaches in the dark woods. He tells the assembled that Lynch has returned, and the depraved are drinking blood. Band together with your fellow Hunters to investigate: It's all of you against the night.
Make Them Bleed began alongside the start of the event, tasking players with collectively gathering points via objectives to unlock new features for the event. Unlike previous community events, progress was able to be tracked in real time with a dedicated page in-game.
Community Objectives:
Interact with Blood Wells - 30 points
Kill Targets - 25 points
Kill Monsters - 1 point

Double XP Weekend Contract
Double XP Weekend Contract ran from September 25th to 28th. As the name suggests, Players gained double the amount during this period to progess faster through the Bloodline.
All Hallows' Cleave
The season of howling winds and all things dead is upon us, and the Corruption could not be more at home. A time of tricks and treats provides the perfect stage for an Incursion-wide monster hunt. It'll curdle your blood, Hunters. Load up and get ready to face the horror.
All Hallows' Cleave began on October 13th and lasted for 20 days, tasking players with collectively gathering points via objectives to unlock new features for the event. Like with Make Them Bleed before, progress was able to be tracked in real time with a dedicated page in-game. Extra objectives were unlocked upon completing some stages.

Are you ready to reap the autumn's harvest, Hunters? A new Community Event brings the opportunity to work together to earn a cornucopia of exciting rewards. We'll start with some Hunt Dollars and Event Points, riches that will flow if you can reach the collective threshold.
